comments.body:
**Validate**, with two nits.

The new `__meta_docker_container_image` / `__meta_docker_container_image_id` labels match how other Docker SD meta labels are built, tests cover the fixtures, and @bboreham already approved.

1. `docs/configuration/configuration.md` does not list these labels yet (the Docker SD meta-label list around `__meta_docker_container_id` / `_name`). Other SD label additions in this repo update that list in the same PR.
2. The IPv6 fixture ends up with empty `image` / `image_id` labels. Optional meta labels elsewhere omit the key when the value is empty, rather than publishing `""`. Worth skipping empty image fields so relabel rules do not have to special-case them.

Neither blocks the feature; I would still merge after the docs line.

Thanks for the notes @aamoghS.
I included both changes to this MR

title: docker SD: add Image + ImageID to labels
